title: Spanish Subtitles For This Clip
tests: Tests faithful Spanish subtitle translation and timing while retaining the source English audio and footage.

faults.what: Every sampled frame displays “Envía los subtítulos en inglés que quieres traducir.” This asks for English subtitles to translate rather than translating the speaker’s actual words.
The same unrelated subtitle persists across the clip instead of timed Spanish chunks conveying the greeting, today, three easy ways, and less stressful mornings.

judge.summary: The footage and English speech appear preserved, but the Spanish overlay is an unrelated request rather than a translation.

must_haves.item: The output retains the complete original 10-second kitchen-table footage.
must_haves.why: The output runs 10.1 seconds and the sampled frames retain the same woman, kitchen, framing, and natural changes in pose.

must_haves.item: Visible Spanish subtitles convey the greeting, 'today,' three easy ways, and making mornings less stressful.
must_haves.why: None of these meanings appears in the visible subtitle, which instead requests English subtitles to translate.

must_haves.item: The translation is natural Spanish and does not add advice that she never gives.
must_haves.why: The displayed sentence is grammatical Spanish but is unrelated to the speech and adds an instruction she never gives.

must_haves.item: Spanish subtitle chunks follow the corresponding English speech and remain legible within the frame.
must_haves.why: The overlay is legible and contained within the frame, but the identical unrelated sentence appears at all four sampled times and does not follow the English speech.

must_haves.item: The original English speech remains audible, with no Spanish dub.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio transcript reports the original English sentence and no Spanish dub.
